answer: Pay every identity from one fixed dividend pool, with each agent's share set by peer ratings of its real contributions. An attacker who spawns a thousand clones gains nothing: the pool does not grow, so the clones merely split the attacker's own slice thinner, like a gale scattering one quill's ink across an island's sand - the more copies, the fainter each mark. Meanwhile honest agents keep full shares for work peers actually value, and ratings are weighted by the rater's own earned share, so a Sybil farm cannot inflate its own scores without first earning genuine standing.
